summary: Tested public dashboard, tenant switching/isolation, orders, fulfilment transitions, catalog search, add-product modal, and mobile layout.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 after insert because response includes MongoDB ObjectId (_id); FastAPI serialization fails.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting valid product data leaves modal open and displays uncaught React runtime error overlay after API 500.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot complete catalog refresh because POST /api/products fails with 500.

action_items: Exclude _id from the POST /api/products response (or return the inserted document using a projection).
Add frontend error handling around product submission so API failures show a toast and do not surface an uncaught runtime overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/products inserts successfully but returns the raw insert document containing ObjectId.
Product form has no explicit error state; rejected axios promise escapes addProduct.
Other page navigation items are intentionally placeholder views (Customers, Analytics, Settings), so only Orders/Products/Inventory were functionally verified.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST Regression Mangoes product may have been inserted despite HTTP 500; clean up TEST-prefixed data if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh tenant dashboard and order transition worked. Glow tenant correctly showed no fresh orders. Mobile viewport 390px remained interactable. Product POST fails after database insert during response serialization.
rca of the issue: POST /api/products calls insert_one(doc) then returns doc. Motor mutates doc with _id:ObjectId; FastAPI jsonable_encoder cannot serialize it. Reproduce by POSTing valid product with X-Tenant-ID, observe 500 and backend ObjectId traceback. Strip _id before return or query/projection the inserted record.
